comment: He is really hard to figure out. He is often lost in his own thoughts. Projects explained and demonstrated but when it comes to what exactly he is looking for, that is another story. Only take this class if you have time. I spend a good 8-10 hours for this class a week and managed to get an A. He can be an awesome prof, takes time.

the first half of the semester is easy. The second half has a ridiculous amount of work, he thinks people take ceramics seriously and expects students to work 8-10 hrs outside of class. He is terrible at explaining what is due and does not use a syllabus or schedule and hates it when you ask him what he was talking about. don't be fooled into this.
DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER!!!!!He is an unbelievable boring and inept teacher and like the other post said I am shocked he still teachers here and has not been fired yet.

He is quite possibly the worst teacher in this entire school. The fact that he has not been fired yet is an atrocity and makes me embarrased to call myself a Richmond Spider. Not only is he terrible at ceramics, he is a terrible teacher. Furthermore, he is not a nice person and is not qualified to teach at this school in any field.
I am an exchange student from Europe and took Mr. Meredith's class in the year 2000/01. He is the best professor ever! Fair and full of understanding.

great guy - has high expectations for what is normally a blow-off class, but he'll help you and he's got a great sense of humor, sometimes you forget he's a professor and talk to him like he's another student.
